## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D Marvel-character fighting game for phones and tablets in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Make gameplay playable and provide responsive, usable touch controls.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained HTML Canvas game with original, simple character illustrations and a rooftop arena.
- Included Spider-Man, Captain America, and Black Panther as selectable heroes; Iron Man is the CPU opponent.
- Added keyboard and touch controls, health/energy meters, attacks, blocking, jumping, specials, rounds, sound effects, and rematch flow.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game in `index.html`.
- Confirmed the inline JavaScript passes `node --check`.
- Captured a browser screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/game.png`.

### Active
- Review the screenshot and test gameplay interactions, including mobile layout and match/rematch flow.
- Resolve any issues found and summarize assumptions when finishing.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` could not launch because its expected Chromium browser was not installed.
- A screenshot was instead captured using system Chromium in headless mode.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/game.png` and assess the initial render.
2. Run targeted browser/gameplay checks if feasible; fix issues in `index.html`.
3. Report completion and brief assumptions; note that changes are uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/game.png`: Latest browser screenshot for visual review.
- `/tmp/opencode/game.js`: Extracted inline script used for syntax validation.

## Important Context
- The development server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- `index.html` is the primary changed file; it is untracked along with other pre-existing project files.

## Objective
- Make the existing 2D superhero fighting game more playable, especially touch controls and clear, fair combat.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks at viewports no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Keep the game as a self-contained HTML Canvas game with original character illustrations and a rooftop arena.
- Playable heroes remain Spider-Man, Captain America, and Black Panther; Iron Man is the CPU opponent.
- Combat uses keyboard/touch controls, cooldowns, guard breaks, specials, rounds, and rematches.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added melee range feedback (“TOO FAR — MOVE CLOSER”) and a facing-direction hint for missed attacks.
- Prevented attacks and movement/block input while a round is inactive; simultaneous left/right input no longer arbitrarily favors right.
- Added special-move feedback for insufficient energy, cooldown, and range.
- Hardened hit/round handling and fixed timer expiration to resolve by health, preserve the current round on a draw, and update the round label.
- `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js` passed after extracting the current inline script.
- Captured and reviewed desktop (1100×900) and mobile (390×844) screenshots; both layouts appeared intact.
- Browser smoke checks confirmed special activation, three-hit guard break with 2.5-second cooldown, and time-up resolution.

### Active
- Finish gameplay verification: the melee smoke check did not register damage, so attack range, cooldowns, facing, and jumping remain unverified in an interactive session.
- Produce the required small JPEG visual-check screenshots; current captures are PNG.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Diagnose and rerun browser melee checks with controlled fighter positions/state; also verify cooldowns, facing, jumping, round progression, and rematch.
2. Convert the reviewed screenshots to JPEG and verify their dimensions are no wider than 1280px.
3. Review the final diff and report the changes and test results.

- `index.html`: Game implementation and current gameplay changes.

- `/tmp/opencode/smoke.cjs`: Browser smoke-check script; melee setup needs correction.

## Objective
- Improve the existing 2D superhero fighting game’s touch controls and make combat clearer and fairer.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks at viewports no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Keep the game as a self-contained HTML Canvas game with original character illustrations and a rooftop arena.
- Playable heroes remain Spider-Man, Captain America, and Black Panther; Iron Man is the CPU opponent.
- Combat uses keyboard/touch controls, cooldowns, guard breaks, specials, rounds, and rematches.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added melee range and facing feedback, plus special-move feedback for insufficient energy, cooldown, and range.
- Disabled attacks and movement while a round is inactive; simultaneous left/right input no longer favors one direction.
- Hardened hit and round handling, including health-based time-up resolution, draws that preserve the current round, and round-label updates.
- `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js` passed after extracting the current inline script.
- Reviewed desktop (1100×900) and mobile (390×844) screenshots; generated JPEGs at those dimensions.
- Browser checks passed for guard break, special activation, and time-up resolution.

### Active
- Run the updated `/tmp/opencode/smoke.cjs` to verify melee range/cooldown/facing, jumping, round progression/draws, and rematch; it was rewritten for these checks but not yet executed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `node /tmp/opencode/smoke.cjs`; diagnose any failing gameplay checks.
2. Review final diff and `git diff --check`, then report changes and test results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game implementation and gameplay changes.
- `/tmp/opencode/smoke.cjs`: Expanded interactive browser test script; pending execution.
- `/tmp/opencode/final-desktop.jpg`: Visual check, 1100×900.
- `/tmp/opencode/final-mobile.jpg`: Visual check, 390×844.

## Important Context
- Repository files remain uncommitted and appear untracked: `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- The earlier melee smoke test was inconclusive because the player and CPU were not reliably configured; the new test sets controlled fighter positions and state.
- `node /tmp/opencode/smoke.cjs` previously verified special activation, guard break (2.5-second cooldown), and `TIME UP — YOU WIN!`; it did not confirm melee damage.
